raw_predicates.T1G: prev1IsBear and (open > close[1]) and (open > open[1]) and (close > open[1]) and isBull
raw_predicates.T1: prev1IsBear and (open >= close[1]) and (open[1] >= open) and (close > open[1]) and isBull
raw_predicates.T2G: prev1IsBull and (open >= open[1]) and (open > close[1]) and (close > close[1]) and isBull
raw_predicates.T2: prev1IsBull and (open >= open[1]) and (open <= close[1]) and (close > close[1]) and isBull
raw_predicates.T3: prev1IsBear and isBull and (open < open[1]) and (open < close[1]) and (close < open[1]) and (close > close[1])
raw_predicates.T5: prev1IsBear and isBull and (open < open[1]) and (open < close[1]) and (close < open[1]) and (close[1] >= close)
raw_predicates.T11: prev1IsBull and isBull and (open < open[1]) and (close >= open[1]) and (close < close[1])
raw_predicates.T12: prev1IsBull and isBull and (open < open[1]) and (close < open[1])

supporting_predicates.fullyEngulfs: eHigh >= ePH and ePL >= eLow and bodyRatioOk
supporting_predicates.anyOtherBullRaw: T1G_raw or T1_raw or T2G_raw or T2_raw or T3_raw or T4_raw or T5_raw or T6_raw or T9_raw or T10_raw or T11_raw or T12_raw
supporting_predicates.anyOtherBearRaw: Z1G_raw or Z1_raw or Z2G_raw or Z2_raw or Z3_raw or Z4_raw or Z5_raw or Z6_raw or Z9_raw or Z10_raw or Z11_raw or Z12_raw
supporting_predicates.Z7_clean: Z7_raw and not anyOtherBullRaw and not anyOtherBearRaw

portability_claim.allowed: THE SAME RECOVERED PINE SEMANTIC PROGRAM, EXECUTED ON MASSIVE SOURCE DATA
portability_claim.why: the legacy comparison target carries its own 2-decimal storage loss; identity with legacy t_sig is not a claim the evidence supports
portability_claim.upgradeable_only_if: the matched cross-feed comparison actually supports the stronger claim

provenance.multiplicity_ledger: NOT reset; a new feed and a new pipeline do not make an exposed hypothesis fresh

naming.display: a report may show the human label T1/T3/...
naming.binding: machine identity must retain the MASSIVE_PORT provenance; legacy names may not be reused as if byte-identical

timeframe_scope.authority: T1_15M_X_ONLY_V1 (status X_ONLY_PRE_Y) is the pre-Y registered family
timeframe_scope.why_explicit: 1H and 1D datasets now exist; dataset availability is NOT hypothesis registration
timeframe_scope.adding_one: a new search-space member requiring its own pre-Y registration

minBodyRatio.declaration: minBodyRatio = input.float(1.0, "Min body ratio", minval=0.5, step=0.05, group=grpE)

pine_input_configuration.legacy_note: Pine inputs are set at runtime; the materialisation's configuration was never captured. This spec does NOT assert the old export ran on defaults.

current_port_configuration.explicitly_not_because: they maximise agreement with the legacy materialisation

sweep_disposition.finding: minBodyRatio=0.5 agreed with the legacy materialisation slightly BETTER than 1.0 (99.1409% vs 99.0827%)
sweep_disposition.reasoning: selecting a parameter by how well it reproduces a target is fitting, not porting — and the target is a rounded column whose disagreements are already known to be storage artifacts
sweep_disposition.what_the_sweep_is_used_for: diagnostic evidence that useWick=False is correct (True costs 6-7 points)

output_model.why: every bar must be inspectable at all three layers for conformance diagnosis
output_model.false_vs_unavailable: FALSE and UNAVAILABLE remain separate at every layer

lookback_and_startup.requirement: exactly one immediately preceding coarse bar
lookback_and_startup.derivation: every recovered predicate references [1] only, including prev1IsBear's Z7_raw[1]
forbidden: treating a missing prior bar as a false predicate

session_semantics.recovered: the T-predicate block contains no session guard, no timeframe request and no reset; predicates reference the previous CHART bar
session_semantics.frozen: no daily reset is introduced, because the source has none
session_semantics.but: a missing or contaminated required prior Massive bar is an unavailable input and may never be bridged as though observed

massive_input_authority.contaminated: UNOBSERVED_CONTAMINATED -> T state UNAVAILABLE, never FALSE
massive_input_authority.forbidden: computing T from contaminated partial OHLC

pairwise_consequence.rule: a T state needs the current AND the immediately preceding 15m interval both COMPLETE
pairwise_consequence.pairwise: LOWER — must be MEASURED in the smoke gate, not assumed
pairwise_consequence.why_flagged: it is the binding availability constraint on the whole port

three_way.B: recovered semantics applied to legacy stored inputs
three_way.C: recovered semantics applied to Massive data

comparisons.A_vs_B: can rounded legacy storage reproduce the historical materialisation?
comparisons.B_vs_C: how much does feed/input data change the SAME executable semantics?

cross_feed_conformance_plan.do_not_collapse: these answer different questions and may not be reported as one match percentage
cross_feed_conformance_plan.identity_rule: matched via the frozen research identity / lineage mapping, NEVER by ticker string alone

legacy_precision_limitation.bound_finding: legacy `bars` OHLC is stored rounded to 2 decimals while Pine operated on higher-precision values
legacy_precision_limitation.consequence: legacy materialised t_sig is NOT a perfect recomputation target from stored rounded OHLC
legacy_precision_limitation.binding: disagreement may not be auto-attributed to implementation error
legacy_precision_limitation.evidence: 74.1% of residuals (33,600 of 45,358) sit on a bar whose current or prior body is at most $0.011

conformance_threshold.rule: this gate MEASURES divergence; whether it is acceptable for a replication-like port is an explicit X-side decision made BEFORE Y
conformance_threshold.forbidden: choosing the threshold after observing Y

required: a wrong source digest is rejected
a contaminated coarse input yields UNAVAILABLE, not FALSE
a missing required prior bar yields UNAVAILABLE
a priority-order permutation changes output and is rejected
raw boolean and final priority-resolved label remain distinguishable
a source-default configuration mutation is rejected
the legacy runtime configuration is not falsely claimed known
a rounded-legacy-OHLC mismatch cannot be auto-labelled an implementation defect
a Massive feed difference cannot be silently ignored
an undeclared T-derived feature is rejected
a Z output request is rejected

next_gate: T PORT SMOKE + MATCHED X-ONLY FEED CONFORMANCE. Full Massive T production is not built automatically.
